LIVE ACTOR-BINDING LAYER (WanefallObjectiveRuntime.h/.cpp): UWanefallMatchRuntimeComponent OWNS all 10 rule machines, with SetupX() selectors, StartMatch(), TickRuntime(Dt), and overlap/interaction handlers (OnRelicPickup, OnPlantTick, OnZoneOccupancyChanged, OnBRElimination, OnExtractTick, OnRaceCheckpoint, etc.). ARENA 4v4 ROUND STATE MACHINE (real, self-driving): AWanefallArena4v4GameState (an AActor, placeable) in WanefallArena4v4GameState.cpp runs EWanefallArenaRoundState Warmup->Countdown->RoundActive->RoundEnding->RoundComplete->Resetting. BeginPlay auto-calls BeginCountdown(); Tick feeds AdvanceRound(DeltaSeconds) + TickBotRespawns. Scores TeamA/TeamB on enemy bot eliminations (opposing team scores), dedupes victims per life, ends on score-limit(25) or round timer(300s), owns a combat event log + local-player downed/death-watch components, and WriteMatchSummary() emits JSON. AWanefallBotLiteEnemy finds it live via TActorIterator<AWanefallArena4v4GameState> and calls RegisterBotElimination.

Also produces HUD mode-list text. This is the only code path that actually travels to a mode map.

SESSION/MATCHMAKING SCAFFOLD (WanefallSessionSystems.h): FWanefallMatchmaker (playlists, SimulateQueue with bot-fill + party-size validation), FWanefallSocialState (party/clan/friends, ValidatePartySize vs mode TeamSize), FWanefallVoiceSystem (channel eligibility), FWanefallTutorialState, FWanefallTelemetryLog. exists: MOVE: AWanefallBotLiteEnemy::Tick drives live navmesh-FREE locomotion via direct SetActorLocation — StepToward() chases (MoveSpeed 340), StrafeStep() laterals (alternating L/R), back-off when inside TooCloseRange (280), and a stuck-safe return-home after StuckResetTime (6s). Rotation faces the target via Dir.Rotation().

AIM/PERCEPTION: HasLineOfSight() does a real ECC_Visibility LineTraceSingleByChannel (eye-height +40z); DetectsTarget() gates on PerceptionRadius (1600) + LOS. FindNearestEnemy() picks nearest different-team alive bot OR the enemy player pawn (no friendly fire).

FIRE/DEAL DAMAGE: BotFireAtEnemy() is the centralized fire path — range (BotPreferredRange 1200) + LOS + cooldown (BotFireCooldown 1.0s) gated, applies real BotDamage 20 via target's UWanefallPrototypeHealthComponent::ApplyPrototypeDamage, emits BotAcquiredTarget/BotFired/DamageApplied events to the arena event bus. Legacy melee TryAttack()/AttackComponent (AttackDamage 10, range 220) also exists.

TAKE DAMAGE: Tick polls its own health each frame; on a health drop it runs TakeDamageReaction -> stagger (StaggerTime 0.55s, no pursuit/attack during) + knockback (200). Wane hazard fields trigger a flee reaction (WaneReactionCheck via TActorIterator over AWanefallWaneHazardField).

DIE/DOWN: lethal damage routes through the shared UWanefallDownedStateComponent (Alive->Downed->BeingRevived->Finished->Eliminated->Reset) with bleedout/revive/finish timers; bot Tick freezes all behaviour while not Alive and dims its material.

RESPAWN: AWanefallArena4v4GameState::TickBotRespawns drives per-bot death-watch (UWanefallDeathWatchComponent, BotRespawnDelay 3s) — down edge auto-finishes (TDM has no allies to revive), elimination edge scores + opens the watch, watch-complete calls Bot->ResetBot()+Activate() in place. ResetBot restores health/threat/downed/deathwatch and teleports to HomeLocation.

TEAMS: EWanefallTeam{Neutral,TeamA,TeamB}; bot has SetTeam/GetTeam; arena scores the OPPOSING team on elimination, dedups per victim per life, tracks A/B scores to ScoreLimit 25 with a full round state machine (Warmup/Countdown/RoundActive/RoundEnding/RoundComplete).

ROUND ORCHESTRATION: ApplyRoundStateToBots() resets+activates the whole roster on RoundActive and resets+deactivates on Warmup/Countdown; RefreshBotRoster() gathers all placed bots via TActorIterator at BeginPlay.

HEADLESS PROOF HOOKS: DamageForProof/ForceDownForProof/FinishForProof/ReviveForProof on the bot and AddBotForProof/TickMatchForProof on the arena make the whole lifecycle deterministically testable without a live tick.
stubbedOrPartial: NO PATHFINDING/NAVMESH: zero references to UNavigationSystem, AIController, MoveTo*, RecastNavMesh, or PathFollowing anywhere in Source. Movement is straight-line SetActorLocation toward the target with sweep=true. Bots cannot route around walls/cover — they will wall-hug or trigger the 6s stuck-reset-to-home. The class header explicitly states 'navmesh-free chase/strafe ... NOT full AI — no behaviour tree, no navmesh, no squad logic, no replication.'

NO TEAM-FILL / ROSTER-SIZE LOGIC: there is NO code that spawns N bots or fills a team up to a required count. No RequiredBots/BotsPerTeam/DesiredCount/fill loop exists. The roster is simply whatever AWanefallBotLiteEnemy actors are HAND-PLACED in the .umap. GetBotsSpawned() just returns Bots.Num() (placed count). The '4v4' name is aspirational — nothing enforces 4 per side.

NO RUNTIME BOT SPAWNING: AWanefallBotLiteEnemy is never created via SpawnActor/NewObject anywhere in source. AWanefallPrototypeThreatSpawner::SpawnEnemyAt spawns only the BASE AWanefallPrototypeEnemy (no behaviour, Tick disabled), MaxEnemies default 1, and is not wired to the bot-lite enemy or the arena.

PROOF HOOKS UNWIRED: AddBotForProof/TickMatchForProof are defined but have no caller in this module (no commandlet/test harness references them in Source) — the headless match-flow path is present but not driven by any found entry point.
AIM IS POSITIONAL ONLY: 'aim' = face-target rotation + a LOS trace + instant hitscan damage application. No projectile, no spread, no lead, no accuracy/difficulty model, no miss chance.

TARGET SELECTION IS NEAREST-ONLY: FindNearestEnemy is pure nearest-distance; no threat weighting, no focus-fire, no target switching hysteresis beyond the LastAcquiredTarget event de-dup ('Bot-lite combat V2 team target selection' = this nearest-enemy different-team picker).

VISUAL IS A PLACEHOLDER CUBE: bot body is /Engine/BasicShapes/Cube scaled 0.9x0.9x1.95 with a color-swap DMI (red/amber/dim). None of the 71 imported Dimwit alien-soldier/mech meshes are referenced by the bot class.
missingForBeta: A spawner/roster manager that, per mode, SPAWNS bots at team spawn points and FILLS each team up to a target count (e.g. fill 4v4 minus human players). This does not exist in any form and is the single biggest gap.

Navmesh navigation: add a RecastNavMeshBoundsVolume per map + either an AIController/behaviour-tree+UPathFollowingComponent or a UNavigationSystemV1::FindPathToLocationSynchronously integration in StepToward, so bots traverse real greybox geometry with cover instead of straight-lining into walls.
Per-map NavMesh build/bake: none of the listed arena .umap files are confirmed to contain a nav volume; every map a bot fights on needs one (or the seek logic stays line-of-sight straight-line only).
Mode-agnostic bot driver: today only AWanefallArena4v4GameState (TDM) orchestrates bots. Other modes (BR/extraction/objective referenced elsewhere) have no bot activation/respawn/scoring wiring.
Wire AddBotForProof/TickMatchForProof (or an equivalent live spawner) into an actual entry point so bots can be created at runtime rather than only hand-placed.
Swap the placeholder cube for the imported Dimwit soldier/mech static (or skeletal) meshes + animation, since bots currently render as scaled cubes.
Difficulty/accuracy model (miss chance, reaction delay, fire-rate scaling) — current fire is deterministic instant-hit at fixed 20 dmg / 1s.

integrationNotes: Reuse AWanefallBotLiteEnemy as-is for per-bot combat behaviour and AWanefallArena4v4GameState as the team/score/respawn shell — both are solid and headless-proven. The exact hooks to extend: (1) Add a runtime spawner that calls World->SpawnActor<AWanefallBotLiteEnemy>(...) at team spawn points and Bot->SetTeam(EWanefallTeam) + arena->RefreshBotRoster()/AddBotForProof — model it after AWanefallPrototypeThreatSpawner::SpawnEnemyAt but for the bot-lite class. The 25 SM_Wpn_Gun_* static meshes drop straight into WeaponBodyMesh->SetStaticMesh() exactly like SM_Rifle already does, so guns are the LOW-effort win (mesh swap + stat table; firing already works). For character selection: the species spine already exists (EWanefallSpecies + ApplySpeciesProfile + EditAnywhere Species + SetSpecies); the minimum wiring is (a) a select UI feeding a chosen value into the pawn, and (b) calling SetSpecies()+re-running ApplySpeciesProfile() on possess/BeginPlay. BUT note the 8 Dimwit soldier identities (Vorlax/ekris/...) do NOT match the 8 code species (Kharvex/...) and are STATIC meshes, so making THEM playable characters needs skeletal-mesh conversion+rigging first; the cheap path is to keep the rigged mannequin body and treat species purely as material/armor identity (as the code already does). Minimum shootable-match path: (1) weapon-data table + mesh-swap in BuildVisibleWeapon, (2) bind 3-4 SM_Wpn_Gun meshes to stat rows, (3) a weapon-cycle input that swaps mesh+stats — no new firing code needed. Per the redesign bible's UWaneSubsystem direction, that id->asset weapon/character registry is the natural home for the missing string-id->mesh bridge.
risks: Dimwit characters are static meshes with no skeleton — using them as playable locomoting pawns is a major art/rigging task, not a wiring task. Treating this as 'just reference the mesh' will fail; only the visible-weapon (static-mesh) use is low-effort.

The species enum names (Kharvex, Veydrin, ...) and the imported soldier names (Vorlax, ekris, zythan, ...) are two unrelated naming systems; any 'select a species/character' design must pick one canonical identity set or it will be incoherent.

Damage values are hardcoded across multiple components (RifleDamage constant, BreacherBaseDamage 24, RelicDamage 95, WaneFangDamage 75) with no central table; adding more guns without a data table will scatter balance further.

Loadout/profile systems are stamped bProofOnly=true and were built as validation telemetry, not gameplay; wiring them live needs care so proof-only assumptions (no real persistence/backend) don't leak into beta.

71 imported assets are entirely unreferenced; if a packaged build strips unreferenced content they may not cook unless explicitly added to a reference (DataAsset/registry) or an Additional Asset Directory.
